1 --- 2 paths: 3 - "**/*.php" 4 --- 5 6 # PHP Rules 7 8 - Framework: custom MVC (PHP 7.4) — no Laravel/Symfony conventions 9 - Namespaces: `Core\`, `Database\`, `Http\`, `Routing\`, `View\`, `Menu\` 10 - Classes: PascalCase / Methods & variables: camelCase / Constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE 11 - DB tables use `nb_` prefix (e.g. `nb_siteinfo`, `nb_admin`) 12 - DB schema changes must go through migration files (`make m`), never alter tables directly 13 14 ## Patterns 15 16 ```php 17 // Routing 18 $router->get('/', function () { 19 return render('pages.index'); 20 })->name('home'); 21 22 // View rendering 23 render('pages.index'); // views/pages/index.php 24 render('pages.works.view', ['no' => $no]); // views/pages/works/view.php 25 ``` 26 27 ## Image Upload & WEBP Optimization 28 29 All Admin image uploads flow through `imageUpload()` in `inc/lib/func.php`. 30 After saving, it automatically calls `\Core\ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling()`. 31 32 ```php 33 // Standard upload call — WEBP sibling is created automatically 34 $result = imageUpload($UPLOAD_DIR_CLIENTS, $_FILES['thumb_image']); 35 $saved = $result['saved']; // e.g. "6830abc.png" — DB stores this, foo.webp created alongside 36 37 // If you add a NEW upload path that bypasses imageUpload(), call manually: 38 move_uploaded_file($tmp, "$dir/$filename"); 39 \Core\ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling("$dir/$filename"); 40 41 // Deletion — imageDelete() handles sibling cleanup automatically 42 imageDelete("$UPLOAD_DIR_CLIENTS/$saved"); // removes .png + .webp 43 ``` 44 45 Rules: 46 - Do not add image resize/convert logic outside `Core\ImageProcessor`. 47 - `makeWebpSibling()` is silent on failure — never throw from it. 48 - Convertible: `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `gif`. Skipped: `svg`, `ico`. 49 - Max width: 2560px (auto-resize).
